must_haves: security and where data is stored (Stockholm)

layout.idea: Editorial long-read: one 640px text column on the left, a wide right margin holding screenshots and short notes as marginalia, like a printed book page.
layout.why: Lets the product be explained in sentences, which suits a careful buyer deciding whether to give an AI their inbox.

hero.idea: Client tabs: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code; each tab shows that client's real screenshot doing the same task.
hero.why: Proves 'works in your client' with real screens.

visual_style.idea: Swiss rules: white ground, heavy 2px ink rules between sections, thin 1px rules inside them, cobalt only as one solid block per section.
visual_style.why: Structure through rules instead of cards and shadows.

typography.idea: Space Grotesk 700 headings at -2% tracking, IBM Plex Sans 400 body, Space Mono 400 for addresses like info@.
typography.why: Technical character without looking like a terminal.

narrative.idea: Demo first: the page opens with a full task walkthrough, and explanation only starts after it.
narrative.why: People believe what they see working.

proof.idea: Data location as a plain label: 'Data stored in Stockholm, Sweden', linking to the sub-processor list.
proof.why: A concrete, verifiable fact for EU buyers.

asset_use.idea: Before and after comparison of the same inbox: a raw inbox screenshot and one with drafts ready, with a draggable divider.

motion.idea: The how-it-works line draws itself once as it enters view (SVG stroke offset), then stays.
motion.why: Draws attention to the data path once.

section_order.idea: Hero (draft card) > Providers strip > How it works (Fig. 1 to 3) > Security model > Use cases by mailbox > Pricing > FAQ > Closing CTA
section_order.why: Leads with the differentiator, then fit, then trust.

voice.idea: Literary and spare. Sample: 'An inbox is a list of small promises. This helps you keep them.'
voice.why: Lifts a utility into something people care about.

wildcard.idea: Every visual carries a museum label with real metadata (what it is, date it shipped).
